tasks.label: Start ViewVee Go Web Server
tasks.command:
set -e
docker rm -f viewvee-web-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker build --file api/Dockerfile --tag viewvee-web:dev api
docker run --detach --rm --name viewvee-web-dev --publish 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 --env SMTP_USERNAME --env SMTP_PASSWORD --env SMTP_HOST --env SMTP_PORT --env SMTP_FROM --env SMTP_FROM_NAME viewvee-web:dev >/dev/null
for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz >/dev/null; then
    echo 'ViewVee Go web server is ready at http://localhost:8080'
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
docker logs viewvee-web-dev
docker rm -f viewvee-web-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo 'ViewVee Go web server did not become ready.' >&2
exit 1
